checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: All five strings correct in every variant
must.why: Vertical 'Visit' renders with a small, odd 'isit' (V large, 'isit' small); otherwise text correct.
Vertical ad's text is small (352px wide); square 20% line and small title are modest; wide fine.
Dark green on cream and cream on green; good contrast, no obstruction.
Square green band is cut off at the bottom, runs to the edge with leaves overlapping; wide band touches the right/bottom edges; 'Visit' glitch is distortion.

must.item: Matching leafy imagery and green-cream styling
must.why: Cream and green with monstera and ferns in all; wide uses a photo-like left block, a bit different.

exact_text.read_as: Visit 24 Willow Lane (vertical: 'Visit' has mismatched small 'isit')

faults.what: Vertical ad: 'Visit' has a mismatched glyph size/weight ('V' large, 'isit' small), a visible text glitch in the address.
Square ad: green band is oddly placed and misaligned, with the left edge inset and leaves overlapping its right side; the layout looks unfinished.
Low resolution (640px); the vertical ad's text is small.
Wide ad: the address band runs flush to the right and bottom edges, and its text is large while other text is small; the style is inconsistent with the other two.

summary: Three cohesive green-and-cream leafy ads with mostly correct text, but the vertical ad's address has a glitched 'Visit', and the square and wide layouts have awkward band placement.
